Affordable Housing Community Improvement Plan – Program Review and Temporary Suspension
Recommendation:
That:
Council directs Staff to temporarily suspend all three financial incentive programs under the Affordable Housing Community Improvement Plan (AHCIP), effective immediately upon Council approval; and further
That:
Staff be directed to undertake a comprehensive review of the AHCIP, including program objectives, eligibility requirements, affordability criteria, funding structure and alignment with current Provincial, Federal and Regional housing priorities, and report back to Council with recommendation regarding the future direction of the Plan.

Award of 2027 Insurance and Risk Management Services
Recommendation:
That:
Council accepts and approves the proposal from BFL Canada Risk and Insurance
Services Inc. for 2027 Insurance and Risk Management Services in the amount of $
926,581.68
(
inclusive of applicable taxes
)
,
and further;
That:
The Contract shall be awarded for an initial term of one (1) year. Pricing shall remain firm for year 2 (2028), provided the town’s loss ratio during the initial term does not exceed 50%. Thereafter, the Town may, at its sole discretion, extend the Contract on the same terms and conditions for up to three (3) additional two-year terms.
